vibe_rationale: Multi-venue winter festival through Yarra's pubs and venues, with a record fair and First Nations program; the closest Melbourne model to SURPLUS, though music-only and council-run.
fit_notes: Creative inner-city music crowd, age unpublished, with weak wellness adjacency. A council expression of interest lets outside groups pitch events, so a stage takeover or stall is a low-cost route. A 2026 program strand carried the name HIGH GROUND, so check for a name clash before any approach.
